# RelayDesk

RelayDesk is an AI-powered email management dashboard for personal assistants and their clients. It organizes conversations, highlights decisions and follow-ups, summarizes threads, and supports assistant-to-client handover.

## Product

- [Sign in](/login): Open the workspace.
- [Create an account](/register): Start a client workspace.

The application is a prototype. Demo workspaces use sample emails and simulated mailbox actions unless a provider account has been connected and authorized.
